ops.reason: The board's February 2010 proposal of a subsidy for renting light and sound equipment for meets held outside club premises is the proposal the March 2010 decision in the staevner rule settled; both regulate the same subsidy.

Both regulate the subsidy paid to clubs that host DM-Hold (divisionsturnering) rounds; the 2026 decision raising the per-round subsidy explicitly removed the 10,000 kr. arrangement filed under the other rule.

Both regulate when and how clubs pay the entry fee to the host club at registration for meets (proof of payment, deadline, Billetto proposal); the decisions share the same subjects across the two rules.

The 2024 decision letting national-team lifters book their own travel within the committee's budget changes the national-team rule on booking travel to international meets, which already covers lifters booking their own flights.
